stories.title: Utah Giving Machine kiosks help fund small businesses worldwide
stories.summary: Donations made through Utah's Giving Machine kiosks help entrepreneurs in countries like Ghana start and grow businesses, creating long-term financial stability for families and communities.

stories.title: Rescue Mission serves hundreds of Thanksgiving meals to homeless Utahns
stories.summary: Hundreds of Utahns experiencing homelessness lined up outside the Rescue Mission of Salt Lake on Wednesday for the annual Thanksgiving banquet.

stories.title: Andy Taylor, guitarist of new wave icons Duran Duran, dies at 65
stories.summary: Andy Taylor, the original guitarist of the 1980s English new wave band Duran Duran, has died. He was 65.

stories.title: Woman dies after suffering medical episode, crashing car
stories.summary: A woman died Wednesday after suffering a medical episode and crashing while driving in South Jordan, police said.

stories.title: UVU Culinary Arts Institute feeds 'elite and gourmet' Thanksgiving meals to nearly 400
stories.summary: A 31-year-old tradition at Utah Valley University that provides a holiday meal for those in need saw its largest attendance ever Tuesday night.

stories.title: Have You Seen This? Man crosses violently rocking foot bridge over gorge in Chile
stories.summary: A tourist in Chile experienced a close call when sudden wind gusts violently rocked the suspension foot bridge over a gorge he was crossing.

stories.title: Utah awards $9.3M to local agricultural producers, food business to strengthen food supply
stories.summary: The Utah Department of Agriculture and Food awarded $9.3 million to 41 local businesses and agricultural producers to increase rural access to Utah's food supply.

stories.title: Man killed by South Jordan police shot at officers first, police say
stories.summary: A man who allegedly threatened a woman with a gun and would not allow her to leave was shot and killed following a confrontation with a SWAT team early Tuesday.

stories.title: Full extent of Christa Pike injuries 'still unknown' 2 months after botched execution, attorney said
stories.summary: The full extent of Christa Pike's injuries is "still unknown" two months after her botched execution, her attorney said in a new legal filing in a Nashville, Tennessee, court.

stories.title: Man accused of shooting out rear window of car that drove around him
stories.summary: A man arrested for allegedly shooting at a car that had driven around him is now facing felony charges.

stories.title: Macy's announces Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday
stories.summary: The Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed as powerful winds are expected to bear down on New York during the annual event, the company said Wednesday.

stories.title: As US pushes to 'win' AI race, politicians and groups call for regulation
stories.summary: Notably, former Utah Sen. Mitt Romney waded into the debate Tuesday with a post on X.
